changelog:
- 新增配方编辑器全屏布局，编辑区更宽敞
- 修复 A1 mini 机型擦料塔默认宽度超出热床的问题
- 修复配方编辑器大图预览时点击选区位置偏移的问题
- 修复配方编辑器全屏模式下弹出菜单不可用的问题
- 修复上传预览中 SVG 线条意外显示的问题
changelog_en:
- Added a fullscreen layout for the recipe editor
- Fixed the prime tower default width exceeding the build volume on A1 mini
- Fixed selection position offset when clicking on large previews in the recipe editor
- Fixed popovers being unusable in fullscreen recipe editor
- Fixed unexpected SVG strokes showing in the upload preview
